question: In the year 2020, the Oriental Bank of Commerce (OBC) and the United Bank of India were merged with which of the following banks ?
solution:
The correct answer is __"**Punjab National Bank**".__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• By combining with **anchor bank PNB** on **April 1, 2020**, **Oriental Bank of Commerce** and **United Bank of India** would possess a combined value of **Rs. 7.95 trillion**, establishing it as India's **second-largest bank**.
